in_marathi.name: Chiyan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chiyan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Chiyan is a name for the moon god, Chandra. It is believed that the moon god has the power to control the tides, seasons, and emotions. Chiyan is a symbol of calmness, tranquility, and protection.
